anhedonia: Loss of interest, reduced enjoyment, lack of motivation, or diminished pleasure in normally rewarding activities.
depressed_mood: Sadness, hopelessness, low mood, tearfulness, despair, or feeling emotionally down.
sleep: Insomnia, difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, early waking, oversleeping, or disrupted sleep.
fatigue: Tiredness, low energy, exhaustion, sluggishness, or feeling physically drained.
appetite: Poor appetite, overeating, eating less than usual, eating more than usual, or appetite change.
self_worth: Guilt, shame, worthlessness, self-blame, feeling like a failure, or feeling burdensome.
concentration: Difficulty focusing, trouble reading, poor attention, indecision, or problems concentrating.
psychomotor: Moving or speaking slowly, being restless, fidgety, agitated, or unable to sit still.
